Hi everyone, I started making a game on the PS4 version of RPG Maker MV before switching to the PC Version. I'd like to use the DLC parts but I haven't been able to find them so maybe someone could help since I'm not good with image stuff.
I'm looking to get all the generator pieces, the map tile sets, and the enemy images. I own all the DLC so if it comes to it I can provide pictures of everything.
I'm hoping for the generator parts at the very least if possible.

posts.author: ATT_Turan
posts.body:
Despite having the same names, the PC and console versions of MV are different pieces of software.
And since these forums only support the PC version, you may not find anyone who knows what you're talking about; and even if they do, there's no way for you to transfer your purchase of DLC between programs.
At the very least, it would help you to provide links and pictures of what this PS4 DLC actually looks like and is named, to see if it has a counterpart released for PC. Your post just as is doesn't really mean anything to us.

posts.author: ATT_Turan
posts.body:
Okay - have you looked through the DLC shop at the top of the page? Or Googled the names? Just by name, most of those are available on PC.
For the VX and XP stuff, you might need to just buy XP or VX and copy the assets over.
But it's probably best to do tutorials then start making your game, and get specific things that you need as your game requires them. I find that a better approach than dropping a lot of money on a bunch of packs, personally.
There are also tons of free resources, including generator parts, if you browse the Resources section of the forum.

posts.author: AquaEcho
posts.body:
Watchlist the sets you want on Steam and wait for a sale. For the XP/Ace assets buy those engines when they go on sale which then gives you the license to use their assets in any project. You can also check this site to see how often any given set goes on sale.
https://steamdb.info/app/741370/

the main problem here is that the japanese developer/publisher labelled two different programs as RMMV.
This is the forum for the PC-version of RMM, which has absolutely nothing to do with the PS4-version of the program. They are similar on the surface only and don't even have the same features.
as such, no one here can really help with the PS4 version
